subject: Scaling blueprint for Sentrix renewal — slot conversion + thermal headroom
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sentrix.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@sentrix.io
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing for renewal: Sentrix Dedicated fleet

Hi Jonas —

Were starting our renewal talks for the dedicated fleet and want to align on sizing before we sign. Our usage pattern has shifted toward longer context inference and synchronous low-latency inference for our moderation path; average session token length is up ~28% month-over-month. Im attaching the May usage export for reference (sentrix_usage_report_May2027.csv).

Key asks:
- Can Redwood recommend an expansion plan that avoids a big SLA bump while keeping unit cost sensible?
- Wed like options: 1) a modest steady-state add, 2) a phased add with burst bridge, and 3) an aggressive upfront add to cover upcoming feature launches.

Were targeting a decision by end of May so procurement can issue PO in early June. Can you propose a recommended path and a rough TCO?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
Sentrix Labs

Attachment: sentrix_usage_report_May2027.csv (CSV, 1.2 MB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sentrix.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing for renewal: Sentrix Dedicated fleet

Laura —

Thanks for the report, its very helpful. Quick read: your 95th percentile token throughput has jumped and prefix cache hit rate fell slightly, which explains the cost step up. I sketched three options below with operational trade-offs. Ive attached a one-page proposal with rough dollars.

Option A — Conservative add (recommended if you want minimal ops): +8 H100 slots (steady-state). Impact: ~18% drop in tail latency at peak, 12% incremental monthly cost. No change to current rollout cadence.

Option B — Phased bridge (best balance): convert 16 of your burst credits into 12 reserved H100 slots + a 2-week burst pool (on-demand) during launch windows. Impact: 32% tail latency improvement during ramp, spreads cost across quarters, preserves fallback to hosted pool. Includes canary policy.

Option C — Proactive surge (feature launch): add 24 reserved H100 slots up-front with a thermal headroom margin for sustained peak. Impact: ~50% tail latency improvement at peak, highest near-term cost.

Operational asks from Redwood:
- We recommend telemetry tagging for the moderation path (a small instrumentation change) so we can verify cache warming and effective KV reuse during rollout.
- A short canary window (48-72h) for Option B/C to validate performance.

Next steps I propose:
1) You pick option A/B/C and indicate preferred start date.
2) We provide a formal SOW and reserve amendment (I attached reserve_proposal_sentrix_v1.pdf).
3) Procurement issues a PO and we schedule onboarding runbook with CS (Vanessa).

Ben (SE) can run a quick capacity simulation if you want numbers translated to expected p50/p95.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

Attachment: reserve_proposal_sentrix_v1.pdf (PDF, 230 KB)

Looping in operational considerations and a small ask from finance.

Laura / Jonas —

Were aligned with Option B as the pragmatic default: it gives you runway for launches while limiting committed dollars. A few notes so expectations are clear:

- Onboarding cadence: our standard Dedicated onboarding for +12 slots takes 7 business days (in-region), +24 slots takes 10-12 business days due to thermal staging. If you want an accelerated window, we can do a 5-day expedited path but it requires pre-provisioning and an elevated onboarding fee.
- Observability: we need the telemetry tag Jonas mentioned. Ben, can you confirm the set of metrics well need (cache hit ratio, avg token time, p95 tail)?
- Billing: finance needs a PO referencing the reserve amendment number. Procurement, if you can provide PO by 3 June, we can lock pricing from the attached proposal for 30 days.

Operational fallback plan we propose for Option B:
1) Provision 12 reserved slots and enable a 2-week burst pool tied to a usage cap.
2) During launch window, enable aggressive prefix caching for the moderation path and monitor p95.
3) If p95 does not improve by 20% after 48 hours, we trigger a temporary top-up of +8 slots from Redwood burst (one-time).

Happy to run through the onboarding checklist with your SREs this week.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Thanks all —

Sentrix will go with Option B (Phased bridge). Procurement will issue PO referencing the reserve amendment and wed like the onboarding to happen the week of June 7. A couple clarifications:

- Please confirm the expected p50/p95 delta youre comfortable guaranteeing for the 12-slot provision (ballpark is fine).
- Wed like the burst pool to be available for 14 days and capped at 1.2x our current 95th percentile to avoid unexpected spend.
- If Redwood can offer pre-provisioning to shorten the onboarding to 5 business days well approve the fee — procurement will include the expedited line item in the PO.

I attached the PO stub so your finance team can prep invoices (PO_78934.pdf). Ill also schedule a quick 30-minute SRE sync with Vanessa and Ben to validate telemetry.
